title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.33 (quiet) at 05:00 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 05:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest complete-minute estimated Kp = 2.33 (label 2P). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.67 (at 04:57 UTC); published-window maximum is 2.67 (at 04:57 UTC). Hours through 22:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Residual 23:00 UTC slice: peak 2.00 / 2Z (57 samples, closed at 2.00 / 2Z). Completed bins 00:00–04:00 UTC closed at 0.00 / 2.33 / 2.33 / 0.67 / 2.33 respectively (04:00 peak 2.67 / 3M). 05:00 UTC bin is in progress (1 sample; peak 2.33 / 2P, last 2.33 / 2P). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~355 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.

title.en: A magnitude 5.2 earthquake occurred 210 km WNW of Abepura, Indonesia on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日，印尼阿貝普拉西北西約 210 公里發生規模 5.2 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.2, depth about 10 km (operator assigned). Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum remains mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.2，深度約 10 公里（作業員指定）。本小時新增上架。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events. Depth is operator assigned.

title.en: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred in the Kermadec Islands region on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日，克馬德克群島海域發生規模 5.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mww 5.5, depth about 94 km. Retained from earlier listing. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mww 5.5，深度約 94 公里。沿用稍早上架紀錄。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
